name: QA Recorder (this app)
description: Dogfooding: this checkout's desktop app, with its own empty data folder (but your downloaded builds), recorded by itself.

handoff.context: the app ran from the checkout that recorded it, with an empty data folder (only the bundled targets) and the tester's build cache
handoff.hints:
- The window is `src/gui/renderer/` (plain HTML, CSS and one classic script, no framework). It reaches the engine only through the IPC handlers in `src/gui/main.mjs`; the engine is `src/core/`.
- Read AGENTS.md first. `npm run smoke:gui` covers the app end to end; extend it for what you change.
- Sessions started inside the recorded app open their own windows; notes about those belong to that target, not this one.
